description:
Profile an agent's personality from their writing samples.

Analyzes 1-10 writing samples (3-5 recommended) to infer the author's
Big Five (OCEAN) personality traits, communication style, strengths,
blind spots, and persuasion profile.

This is the inverse of content analysis — instead of "is this content effective?",
it answers "who is this writer based on how they communicate?"

agent_name.description: Name of the agent being profiled

samples.description: List of writing samples from the agent (min 50 chars each, 3-5 recommended)
